result.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
result.summary: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiaCap，一个统一输出转写、时间戳与说话人视觉描述的音视频对话字幕 LLM，采用合成标注预训练加细粒度奖励强化学习的两阶段训练，并扩展 DiaDemBench 评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于音视频字幕与说话人日记化任务，输出为感知层面的结构化标注，不涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或推理期计算决策，仅有较通用的多阶段 RL 奖励分解，尚无可具体迁移到 LVR 的线索。
